definitions.explanation: A gray like the fur of a mouse, slightly darker than light gray; a traditional color word, also written {鼠色|ねずみいろ}.

examples.japanese: ねずみ{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧。

examples.english: The sky was covered with gray clouds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ねずみ{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作業着|さぎょうぎ}→作業着：24135_sagyougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My father always goes to the factory in gray work clothes.

notes:
A native color word that feels a little old-fashioned; ⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧ and ⟦グレー→グレー：24406_guree⟧ are the everyday words. Also written {鼠色|ねずみいろ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧: gray, the general word
- ⟦グレー→グレー：24406_guree⟧: gray, the loanword, common for clothes and fashion
